why: All the figures are the same notched shape, only turned to different angles, except two: figures 2 and 5 are mirror images (flipped over), so their tall end is on the other side of the round notch. Turning a shape can never make its mirror image. So the answer is 'Both 2 and 5'. Figure 3 looks like 2, but it is only turned, not flipped. Figures 1, 3, 4 and 6 are only turned copies.
trick: Walk around the outline in one direction and list the sides (long, tall, notch, short). A mirrored shape gives the list in reverse order.
note: Book key prints 2, but in the figures both 2 and 5 are flipped, so the option 'Both 2 and 5' was added (user's decision).
